commitResults.messageTitle: Limit email length to prevent a stack overflow
commitResults.messageBody:
A very long email with many domain labels overflowed the stack during
regex matching. The resulting StackOverflowError was uncaught, so the
user received no feedback.

Reject emails longer than 254 characters before running the regex, and
state the limit in the validation message.

commitResults.messageTitle: Include confirm/y in the add command usage message
commitResults.messageBody:
The add usage message omitted the optional confirm/y parameter, although
the command accepts it and the User Guide documents it.
Beta bug fixes, limit checks and UI
